@Paige Ormiston - this applies to the instances where the Undo button can be found in the chat, but I think this is the best use from the A11y side. There's no time limit, keyboard users won't have a lot of focus stops to get to the Undo button, screenreader users can get to it quickly as well, and if a magnification user's view is already in the chat, it's likely they'll see this quickly :sparkle:

@Paige Ormiston - would there be any chance of changing the first 'Closed tabs' to Action Log or something similar? this doesn't fail anything a11y wise but I wonder if the redundant names could cause some confusion. what do you think?

@Paige Ormiston when it comes to this version and 'Close current tab' in v2 (or even in the prototype), I do like this for the sake of accessibility. There's no time limit here and gives a confirmation message in case the user made a mistake or changes their mind. 

I would say if they choose to close the tab, adding this to the Action log or just some 'this has been closed' type of message would be great to let the user know. 
* Users with cognitive disabilities benefit  -if a user struggles with memory they're reminded it's closed.
* Screenreader users benefit  -the text would be available for them to navigate to
* magnification users benefit  -removes the need to check the tab strip to determine if the tab was closed

If you have any questions, please let me know! :star:

hi @Paige Ormiston ! I'm putting this comment here since I know the topic of 'timer', 'countdown' and such is used in several areas. 

Based off of WCAG 2.2.3 No Timing (https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/no-timing) we want to avoid the use of time limits as much as possible. It can impact multiple user groups and assistive tech users - those with physical disabilities, cognitive disabilities, screenreader users, those with low vision, magnification users. 

If a timer/time limit needs to be added, we want to make sure we're giving enough time and an option for users to add more time if they need it (like pausing or stopping the countdown) / source: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/timing-adjustable.html

Please let me know if you have any additional questions on this. thank you! :grin:
